nodes.title: Fix the failing Docker build and restore deployment
nodes.summary: The Docker build fails at `npm run build` because `tsc` reports a syntax error in `src/sideSnap.test.ts` (line 26). Several files also start with a stray `// FILE:` header line: `.dockerignore`, `.nvmrc`, `src/sideSnap.ts`, `src/snapping.ts`, `src/circleSnap.ts`, `src/hoverSide.ts`, `src/components/CursorPreview.tsx` and their tests. Remove these headers and fix the syntax error. Confirm that `npm ci && npm run build` passes locally, then redeploy. Without the `.dockerignore` fix, the ignore rules are not applied correctly and the image build context includes unwanted files. Without the `.nvmrc` fix, the Node version pin is invalid.
nodes.detail: {"planState":"tasks_created"}

nodes.title: Add build verification and clean up dependency vulnerabilities
nodes.summary: Run `npm test` and `tsc` in CI or a pre-deploy check so syntax and type errors are caught before the Docker image is built. Triage the 6 `npm audit` findings (2 critical, 1 high, 3 moderate), upgrading dev-only packages such as vite, vitest and jsdom where safe. Replace the deprecated `whatwg-encoding` dependency. Pin the Node version consistently across `.nvmrc`, `package.json` engines and the Dockerfile base image.
